name: Wang He
current_role: Founder and CTO, Galbot (银河通用); tenure-track Assistant Professor, Peking University
profile: Embodied-AI researcher (He Wang) who leads Peking University's EPIC lab and in 2023 founded Galbot, a Beijing general-purpose robotics company built around its 'AstraBrain' embodied foundation model and sim-to-real synthetic data. Galbot's wheeled humanoids (G1, S1) are deployed in retail pharmacies, factories and logistics; backers include CATL, SAIC Motor, Sinopec, China Mobile and Qiming Venture Partners.
interesting_fact: On 9 Feb 2026 President Xi Jinping inspected the Galbot G1 robot in Beijing and met him; he is also an MIT Technology Review 'Innovators Under 35' (China, 2025) honoree and an ICRA 2026 keynote speaker.
deep_cut_fact: He is first author of NOCS ('Normalized Object Coordinate Space', CVPR 2019), a widely cited method for category-level 6D object pose estimation, and won a 2019 Eurographics Best Paper nomination before turning to robotics startups.
notes: Galbot's own site links 'meet the founder' to his academic homepage. Academic email is the most direct published route; also on MIIT/CAAI embodied-AI committees.
